question.text: A pressure cooker reduces cooking time for food because

options.text: boiling point of water involved in cooking is increased
the higher pressure inside the cooker crushes the food material
cooking involves chemical changes helped by a rise in temperature
heat is more evenly distributed in the cooking space

solution.text: On increasing pressure, the temperature is also increased. Thus in pressure cooker due to increase in pressure the b.p. of water increases.
